name: B10-0261/2025 (S&D) – Arrest and risk of execution of Tundu Lissu, Chair of Chadema, the main opposition party in Tanzania
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the arrest and risk of execution of Tundu Lissu, Chair of Chadema, the main opposition party in Tanzania
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly criticises Tanzania's government for cracking down on opposition members and critics. It calls for the immediate release of Tundu Lissu, the main opposition party leader, who was arrested and charged with treason, a crime that can carry the death penalty. It also asks Tanzania to stop arresting opponents, respect free speech and fair elections, stop executions, and fix its cybercrime and media laws. The Parliament asks the European Union to watch trials of government critics.

- The Parliament demands Tundu Lissu's release; Tanzania's government decides.
- Tanzania is urged to stop cracking down on opponents and hold fair elections.
- The European Union is asked to monitor trials of government critics.
